identity.name: Fifty Fathoms Bathyscaphe
identity.one_liner: The 43mm Bathyscaphe — the smaller, more wearable Fifty Fathoms with a ceramic bezel and the 1315 caliber, designed as the everyday-luxury diver.

narrative.story: The Bathyscaphe line references the 1956 Blancpain Bathyscaphe (named for Auguste Piccard's deep-sea submersible). The 2013 reissue scaled the Fifty Fathoms case down from 45mm to 43mm and swapped the sapphire bezel for ceramic — a lighter, more everyday wearable result. The 1315 caliber (120-hour reserve) is the same as in the 45mm Fifty Fathoms. The Bathyscaphe is the most-cited modern Blancpain for daily wear and the watch a collector cites when they want the Fifty Fathoms heritage in a case that fits under a cuff.
narrative.collector_notes: The Bathyscaphe is 43mm vs the Fifty Fathoms 45mm; the bezel is ceramic (not the sapphire of the 45mm). The 1315 caliber runs at 28,800 vph with a 120-hour reserve.
